Overview

Self-consistent field (SCF) solvers for both closed-shell (RHF) and open-shell (UHF) wave functions, with Pulay DIIS convergence acceleration and canonical orthogonalization.

Header: include/scf.hpp Source: src/scf.cpp

For the theoretical background see Restricted vs Unrestricted HF and Pulay DIIS Convergence Acceleration.

Settings

struct SCFSettings

All SCF parameters, parsed from the [scf] section of the TOML input.

int max_iter

Maximum number of SCF iterations before stopping. Default 100.

double convergence

Convergence threshold \(\varepsilon\) applied to both \(|\Delta E|\) and \(\text{RMS}(\Delta\mathbf{P})\). Default 1e-8.

int diis_size

Number of (Fock, error) vector pairs retained in DIIS memory. When the queue is full the oldest pair is discarded. Default 8.

double screen_tol

Schwarz screening threshold forwarded to build_JK(). Default 1e-10.

Result Types

struct RHFResult

Converged RHF solution.

bool converged

true if convergence was reached within max_iter.

int n_iter

Number of SCF iterations performed.

double E_elec

Electronic energy \(E_\text{el}\) in Hartree.

double E_nuc

Nuclear repulsion energy in Hartree.

double E_total

Total energy \(E_\text{total} = E_\text{el} + E_\text{nuc}\).

torch::Tensor C

MO coefficient matrix, shape \([N_b, N_b]\). Columns are MOs ordered by energy (lowest first).

torch::Tensor eps

Orbital energies, shape \([N_b]\), ascending order.

torch::Tensor P

Final AO density matrix, shape \([N_b, N_b]\).

torch::Tensor F

Final Fock matrix (possibly DIIS-extrapolated), shape \([N_b, N_b]\).

struct UHFResult

Converged UHF solution.

Follows the same energy fields as RHFResult, plus:

torch::Tensor Ca

Alpha MO coefficient matrix.

torch::Tensor Cb

Beta MO coefficient matrix.

torch::Tensor eps_a

Alpha orbital energies (ascending).

torch::Tensor eps_b

Beta orbital energies (ascending).

torch::Tensor Pa

Alpha density matrix.

torch::Tensor Pb

Beta density matrix.

double S2_exact

Exact expectation value \(S(S+1)\) where \(S = (N_\alpha - N_\beta)/2\).

double S2_uhf

UHF expectation value of \(\hat{S}^2\) including spin contamination:

\[\langle\hat{S}^2\rangle_\text{UHF} = S(S+1) + N_\beta - \sum_{i,j}\bigl|\langle\phi^\alpha_i|\phi^\beta_j\rangle\bigr|^2.\]

Solver Functions

RHFResult run_rhf(const Molecule &mol, const BasisSet &bs, const SCFSettings &settings)
Parameters:

  • mol – Molecular system.

  • bs – Fully loaded and normalised basis set.

  • settings – SCF tuning parameters.

Returns:

RHFResult with converged (or best-so-far) data.

Algorithm:

  1. Build \(\mathbf{S}\), \(\mathbf{H}^{\rm core}\), Schwarz matrix \(\mathbf{Q}\).

  2. Canonical orthogonalization → \(\mathbf{X}\) (threshold \(10^{-8}\)).

  3. Core-Hamiltonian initial guess: diagonalise \(\mathbf{H}^{\rm core}\), form \(\mathbf{P}^{(0)}\).

  4. DIIS-accelerated iteration:

    1. Form \(\mathbf{J},\mathbf{K}\) via build_JK() with density \(\mathbf{P}\).

    2. Assemble \(\mathbf{F} = \mathbf{H}^{\rm core} + \mathbf{J} - \tfrac{1}{2}\mathbf{K}\).

    3. Compute DIIS error \(\mathbf{e} = \mathbf{F}\mathbf{P}\mathbf{S} - \mathbf{S}\mathbf{P}\mathbf{F}\).

    4. Push \((\mathbf{F}, \mathbf{e})\) to DIIS; extrapolate \(\mathbf{F}_\text{DIIS}\).

    5. Compute energy \(E = \tfrac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}[\mathbf{P}(\mathbf{H}^{\rm core}+\mathbf{F})]\).

    6. Diagonalise \(\mathbf{X}^\top\mathbf{F}_\text{DIIS}\mathbf{X}\); form new \(\mathbf{P}\).

    7. Check \(|\Delta E| < \varepsilon\) and \(\text{RMS}(\Delta\mathbf{P}) < \varepsilon\).

Prints a convergence table to stdout during iteration.

UHFResult run_uhf(const Molecule &mol, const BasisSet &bs, const SCFSettings &settings)
Parameters:

  • mol – Molecular system.

  • bs – Basis set.

  • settings – SCF settings.

Returns:

UHFResult.

Same overall algorithm as run_rhf() but maintains separate DIIS queues, density matrices, and Fock matrices for \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) spins.

The UHF energy functional is:

\[E_\text{el} = \tfrac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\bigl[ (\mathbf{P}^\alpha+\mathbf{P}^\beta)\mathbf{H}^{\rm core} + \mathbf{P}^\alpha\mathbf{F}^\alpha + \mathbf{P}^\beta\mathbf{F}^\beta\bigr].\]

Internal: canonical_orthogonalization

static std::pair<torch::Tensor, int> canonical_orthogonalization(const torch::Tensor &S, double thresh = 1e-8)

Returns the transformation matrix \(\mathbf{X}\) and the number of linearly independent columns retained. Eigenvalues of \(\mathbf{S}\) below thresh are discarded.

Uses at::linalg_eigh(S, "L") which returns eigenvalues in ascending order; the last n_ind are kept.

Internal: DIIS

struct DIIS

Pulay DIIS extrapolation state machine.

explicit DIIS(int sz)

Construct with maximum subspace size sz.

void push(const torch::Tensor &F, const torch::Tensor &e)

Append a (Fock matrix, error vector) pair. If the queue exceeds max_size, the oldest pair is evicted.

torch::Tensor extrapolate()

Solve the DIIS linear system (see DIIS Linear System) and return the extrapolated Fock matrix. Falls back to the most recent Fock matrix if the \(\mathbf{B}\) matrix is singular (at::linalg_solve fails).
